subject: Trading
title: How Puts Work
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on How Puts Work.

hook.text: You own shares at $100 and fear a drop. A $95 put costs $3 and guarantees you can sell at $95 no matter what happens.

buildup.text: A put option gives you the right to sell 100 shares at the strike price before expiration.

discovery.text: Puts increase in value when the stock falls. If the stock drops to $80, your $95 put is worth at least $15.

twist.text: Puts work like insurance. You pay a small premium to protect against large downside moves.

climax.text: Traders use puts to hedge existing positions or to profit from expected declines—without shorting stock.

punchline.text: Bearish or protective? Puts are your tool.

quiz.question: When does a put option increase in value?
options: When the stock price falls below the strike
